target: Complete a shared legacy round only after every user-bearing conversation has its own final answer.
primary_semantics: Conversation-scoped completion is universal across the round's user conversations, not existential.
invariants: Raw dialogue and summaries remain unchanged.
An unresolved conversation keeps the shared round incomplete.
The completed state is reached after every corresponding conversation final is present.
allowed_changes: Correct recovered completion set logic and its exact regression, version metadata, and release documentation.
prohibited_changes: Run a broad full-release rehearsal for this narrow patch.
before_after_checks: Assert partial shared-round completion remains incomplete.
Append the second conversation final and assert completion.
Repair derived state and require heartbeat ok with zero integrity or repairable issues.

original_triggers: The v2.12.5 duplicate-round regression expected a globally completed round while another conversation in that round remained unresolved.
Post-install heartbeat exposed completed-round and pending-round projection drift.
